messages:
maria-ml: Heads-up — planning to resample the prompt set for the new 4-bit quantized bring-up. Need to refresh the golden set and decide labeler batching. timeline: next Thursday for initial smoke.

kevin-eng: Sounds good. Are we keeping golden at ~1k or bumping to 2k for more coverage (esp. code & task-switching prompts)?

sara-curation: I'd vote for stratified golden: keep ~1k core golden (+~800 satellite). stratify by domain (chat, code, search, instruction), and by severity buckets (n=high/n=low). aim: ~200–300 per domain in the core gold. also we should re-run de-dupe with embedding-sim threshold 0.88 and a post-fingerprint pass — saw collisions last run.

aj-ops: For labeler throughput: keep UI batches at 120–150 items. larger batches cause timeouts in the review UI and more resends. if we need faster turnaround, spin parallel jobs not larger batches. also note: labelers prefer compact JSONL, not CSV — CSV broke the schema last month.

labeler-bot: New job created: #labeling-job/1775004, batch_size=120, schema=compact-jsonl, priority=high

kevin-eng: We should add a tiny smoke eval for the quantized model on the golden set before any wide rollout. pass/fail: no >2% relative drop on prompt_quality_score and no catastrophic hallucinations on the top 50 safety prompts. quick sample command I used last time:

```
python tools/eval_run.py \
  --model redwood-quant-v1 \
  --promptset data/golden/stratified_2026.jsonl \
  --seed 42 \
  --metrics prompt_quality_score,bleu,exact_match \
  --out results/quant-smoke.json
```

leila-ml: Add to that: require mean BLEU change <= 1.5 and run interactive spot-checks for code generation prompts (10 samples per model). I'll take the spot-checks if you create the workitem. Also we should store the golden_version tag with git SHA and quantization recipe id.

maria-ml: Action items: (1) sara to produce stratified sample and de-dupe with embedding thresh=0.88 by Tue EOD, (2) aj to create labeling job with batch_size=120 and compact-jsonl schema, (3) kevin to wire the smoke eval script and define pass/fail, (4) leila to run spot-checks after smoke passes. I'll follow up with a tiny PR linking the goldset and eval notebook. Thanks all :thumbsup:
